```plato

//==
// # Differentiable field interfaces
//
// Scalar and vector fields that carry a first derivative alongside their
// value: the gradient of a scalar field, and the Jacobian, divergence, and
// curl of a vector field. Derivatives may be analytic or numeric; either way
// they are exposed as ordinary field operations
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Differentiable_function).

// A planar scalar field with an analytic or numeric first derivative. The
// gradient points in the direction of steepest increase
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gradient).
interface IDifferentiableScalarField2D
    inherits IScalarField2D
{
    GradientAt(x: Self, point: Point2D): Vector2D;
}
```
